description.value: West Coast Natural Foods is a long-established health food store in Sooke serving the community since 1980. It carries organic and natural groceries including quality meat and fish alongside a broad range of vitamins, minerals, herbal remedies, and nutritional supplements from brands such as Natural Factors, Sisu, and Flora. For a touring cyclist passing through Sooke, it offers a compact resupply stop for whole foods and wellness products.
